patterns: Founder one-liners dominate: Satyashodhak Samaj = Jyotiba Phule (asked many times), Self-Respect = Periyar, Bahishkrit Bharat = Ambedkar, Vital-Vidhvansak = Walangkar.
APPSC asks the AP angle: Justice Party created Andhra University (1926), first Adi-Andhra session in Krishna district, Bhagya Reddy Varma, Arundhatiya Yuvajana Sangham.
Movement-to-nature questions: Vaikom = temple entry; Satyashodhak = anti-caste movement in Maharashtra; Satnami = Guru Ghasidas.
Traps: Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha wrongly paired with Phule; Mahad = water, not temple; Anti-Untouchability League first president G.D. Birla.
App MCQs go much deeper into Justice Party ministries, Adi-Andhra conference office-bearers and dates than any PYQ shows.
